ns2:course.label: Biomechanics of Human Movement
ns2:course.description: Studies the biological and mechanical principles of human motor performance; analyzes selected movement skills in depth. Prerequisite: MCB 334, MATH 012 or above, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MCB 334, MATH 012 or above, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Additional Class Materials fee required. Students must register for one lab-discussion and one lecture section.
